subject: Norwood Public Schools
measure: Full-day school closures due to snow or winter weather

counting_rules.snow_day: One scheduled instructional day canceled district-wide due to snow, ice, or winter weather
exclude: Reserved snow make-up days not actually used

note: Published calendars reserve potential make-up days but do not establish how many weather closures actually occurred. Verify dated closure announcements and final adjusted calendar for each school year.
